hooks.prompt: Before the assistant stops, verify that all recent actions (code generation, file creation/modification, architectural decisions) comply with the project's CLAUDE.md instructions. Read CLAUDE.md, identify what was done in the conversation, and produce a compliance report. If there are violations, block the stop and explain what needs to be fixed. If the conversation was purely informational with no code/file changes, report clean compliance. Use $ARGUMENTS for context.
